dialogues.text: Notice Reiterating Relevant Production Zone Regulations

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Bringing items not related to production into the production zone is forbidden, including Genius Invokation TCG cards, books, etc.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Complete production work in a timely manner and ensure all products meet quality standards. Be willing to accept technical assistance when necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: Take good care of equipment! Stealing any production materials or modifying the clockwork meka is strictly forbidden.
